title: RREV Awardee Schools
before:
Although the funding for these RREV awarded pilots has ended, they continue to influence innovation across the State. As part of the open licensing requirement with the Federally awarded RREV grant, all materials developed by schools/districts that were awarded funding are open to the public to use, reuse, modify and share using the CC BY-NC-SA license. (See icon below.) We continue to add media content so check back often. Our videos capture innovation in action and our interviews help share the voices of innovation.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
decisions.why: It repeats the page title in picture form, which the new banner already does in type.

decisions.label: Size an image by its shape
decisions.why: "Creative Commons Logo" measures 403×141 — it was sitting in the flow at its own pixel size, aligned with nothing.

decisions.label: Stop a picture floating with nothing beside it
decisions.why: 1 picture is set to float so text runs up beside it, but what follows it is a grid, a card or a table — a box, which clears the float rather than wrapping. So the picture sits alone with a column of white to its right and everything below starts past the bottom of it. Unfloated it is a picture in the flow, which is what it already looked like.
